name: openclaw-pstack
description: Pstack owns workflow; OpenClaw owns secure execution.

cliCommands.name: pstack
cliCommands.description: Integrity and one-time legacy state import

bareRouteAliases.description: Explicitly opt in to the 57 bare route names; native host collision/reserved-name checks remain authoritative. Never enables loop or other native extensions.

nativeWaitSeconds.description: Bounded wait, in seconds, a native controller command spends collecting pending children before it hands off to /pstack resume or a scheduled continuation.

trailInRestrictedSessions.description: Let the optional pstack_trail append in sessions whose filesystem policy is workspaceOnly or unknown. The host does not tell plugin tools about read-only permission mode, so enable this only when no read-only session can call pstack_trail.
